Name: Better Events Core
Author: darthalex2014
Description:
[b][size=4]Also: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29557]Events Editor[/url]
Here are some of the commands you can use (For Events):[/size][/b]
[b]removeClothes [/b][all/bottom/top]: Undresses the farmer.
[b]saveClothes [/b]<slotName>: Saves the farmer's current outfit to a slot with the specified name. Useful for restoring specific outfits later.
[b]restoreClothes [/b]<slotName>: Restores the farmer's outfit from the specified slot.
[b]loopSound[/b] <soundName> <delay> [repeatCount]: Plays a sound repeatedly with a specified delay between repetitions. The optional repeatCount determines how many times the sound is played.
[b]loopSoundStop[/b] <soundName>: Stops a repeating sound.
[b]advShake[/b] <targetName> <amplitudeX> <delayX> <amplitudeY> <delayY>: Animates a character by shaking them horizontally and vertically. Replace targetName with either "farmer" or the name of an NPC in the event.
[b]advShakeStop[/b] <targetName>: Stops the shaking animation for the specified target.
[b]timeSkip[/b] <timeToAdd>: Adds a specified number of time to the current in-game time. (This can be used to simulate time passing during an event or to trigger time-dependent actions.)

[b][size=4]OMG:[/size][/b]
[b]loopSound[/b] This command can be used to play sounds during [b][u][size=4]speak or message commands[/size][/u][/b] for layered sound effects.

[b][u][size=4]Example:[/size][/u][/b]
[u][b]For sound in speak:[/b][/u]
/[b]loopSound[/b] gulp 35 
/[b]loopSound[/b] slimeHit 80
/pause 2000
/speak Penny \"Gulp... M-m-ph... Gulp...\"
/[b]loopSoundStop [/b]gulp
/[b]loopSoundStop [/b]slimeHit

[b][u]Example Usage dress/undress:[/u][/b]
message \"The farmer is taking off his shirt...\"
[b]/saveClothes[/b] standart 
[b]/removeClothes[/b] top
[b]/saveClothes[/b] withpants
/message \"The farmer is taking off his pants...\"
[b]/removeClothes[/b] bottom
/message \"The farmer is putting on his pants...\"
[b]/restoreClothes[/b] withpants
/message \"The farmer is putting on his shirt...\"
[b]/restoreClothes[/b] standart 

[b][u]OR:[/u][/b]
message "The farmer is undressing..."
[b]/removeClothes[/b] all
